<thought>The carbon NMR shows peaks at 151.28, 134.64, 132.51, 124.01, 123.09, and 122.26 ppm, all within the typical aromatic region (≈110‑160 ppm). The other peaks correspond to carbonyl and aliphatic carbons. Thus there are six aromatic carbon signals.</thought>
